label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
**Subject: Lotus Glow Nails is closed this week (everybody is OK!)**

Dear friends, neighbors, church family, and my ladies,

My phone has been ringing nonstop, so I am writing one letter to answer everybody at once.

Yes, it is true. On Sunday, November 8, around 2 in the morning, a lady drove her car through the front window of Lotus Glow Nails on Bellaire Blvd. Nobody was inside. The driver is OK. The police came, and her insurance is paying for the damage.

The front glass is gone and one pedicure chair is smashed. The car stopped exactly at the pedicure chair, like she wanted a spa day. My daughter says she got the first drive-thru pedicure in Houston. The floor looks like a rainbow threw up. My husband says after 11 years the shop is finally modern art.

Here is what you need to know:

When we reopen: The city inspector has to check the wall first. My contractor says we open again Monday, November 16. If that changes, I will let you know.

Where to find me this week: Trang, Kim, and I are working at my cousin Hoa's salon, Pearland Nail Bar. Call or text my cell at 832-555-0147 and I will fit you in.

Gift cards: Still good. Nobody loses any money.

And me? I am OK. I cried a little in the morning, but now I am fine. God protected us, because nobody was inside. A window and a chair we can replace.

Thank you for all the texts and the food. Mrs. Dung brought pho this morning, so I am not going hungry. Please don't worry about me. Laugh a little, then come see me in Pearland this week, and come see the new window on the 16th.

Please pass this along to anybody who is asking.

Love,
[Your name]
Lotus Glow Nails

Put your name at the bottom the way your customers know you. I didn't have the address for Pearland Nail Bar, so the letter only tells people to call or text you; add the address after the salon name if you want it in there.
